name: Kou Tomoe
source:
Likes: Chocolate, partying 
Dislikes: Romance dramas, opportunist people

Best friend of Hana, he is quite popular but he doesn’t like to boast about it.
He is someone who changed a lot by meeting Hana and Natsume.
Lately, he is quite busy for unknown reasons.
